pages.quiz:
GERMAN — TERMLY EXAM #18 (TERM 3)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which German word or phrase means "please"? (1 mark)
   A. Bis morgen
   B. Bitte
   C. Guten Tag
   D. Hallo

2. What does "Uhr" mean in "sechs Uhr"? (1 mark)
   A. day
   B. week
   C. o'clock
   D. month

3. Which German word or phrase means "son"? (1 mark)
   A. die Schwester
   B. die Mutter
   C. der Bruder
   D. der Sohn

4. What does "jung" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. small
   B. young
   C. funny
   D. old

5. Which German word or phrase means "sofa"? (1 mark)
   A. der Topf
   B. der Stuhl
   C. das Sofa
   D. der Löffel

6. Which German word or phrase means "kitchen"? (1 mark)
   A. das Schlafzimmer
   B. die Küche
   C. das Messer
   D. der Teller

7. Which German word means "to see"? (verb) (1 mark)
   A. riechen
   B. schwimmen
   C. sehen
   D. trinken

8. Which German word means "to read"? (verb) (1 mark)
   A. hören
   B. trinken
   C. tanzen
   D. lesen

9. Which little word goes with the noun "Kuchen"? (1 mark)
   A. die
   B. den
   C. das
   D. der

10. What does "der dritte" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. third
   B. eighth
   C. second
   D. first

11. What does "der achte" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. tenth
   B. eighth
   C. third
   D. seventh

12. Which German word or phrase means "carrot"? (1 mark)
   A. das Brot
   B. der Kohl
   C. die Karotte
   D. die Mango

13. Which food group does "der Saft" belong to? (1 mark)
   A. das Gemüse
   B. das Obst
   C. die Getränke
   D. das Fleisch

14. Which German word or phrase means "supper"? (1 mark)
   A. der Mais
   B. das Abendessen
   C. die Tomate
   D. der Käse

15. Which word has a silent h that makes the vowel long? (1 mark)
   A. Bauch
   B. Kopf
   C. Mund
   D. Zahn

16. What is the plural of "der Zahn"? (1 mark)
   A. die Zahne
   B. die Zahns
   C. die Zähner
   D. die Zähne

17. Which German word means "cloudy"? (weather) (1 mark)
   A. wolkig
   B. trocken
   C. kalt
   D. windig

18. Which little word goes with the noun "Wolke"? (1 mark)
   A. den
   B. die
   C. der
   D. das

19. Which completes "Das Bild hängt an ___ Wand"? (1 mark)
   A. dem
   B. den
   C. das
   D. der

20. What does "unter" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. above
   B. on
   C. in front of
   D. under

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Write the German names of these months: January, February, March. (3 marks)

22. Write the German words with der, die or das for: lunch, carrot. (2 marks)

23. Explain when we use dem and when we use der after a position word like auf or neben. (3 marks)

24. Write the German words with der, die or das for: spoon, supper. (2 marks)

25. Write the German words with der, die or das for: cloud, cake, toe. (3 marks)

26. Write the German names of these months: October, November, December. (3 marks)

27. Write the German words with der, die or das for: grandmother, clock. (2 marks)

28. Write three words from a Kenyan greeting or from German that must begin with a capital letter, and say why. (3 marks)

29. Write the German words with der, die or das for: knee, garden. (2 marks)

30. Write in German: "The lamp is next to the bed." (2 marks)

31. Give two safety rules for sending messages online. (2 marks)

32. Write the German words with der, die or das for: table, fridge, kitchen. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — TERMLY EXAM #18 (TERM 3) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — Bitte
   please in German is Bitte.

2. C — o'clock
   sechs Uhr is six o'clock.

3. D — der Sohn
   son in German is der Sohn.

4. B — young
   jung means young.

5. C — das Sofa
   sofa in German is das Sofa.

6. B — die Küche
   kitchen in German is die Küche.

7. C — sehen
   to see in German is sehen.

8. D — lesen
   to read in German is lesen.

9. D — der
   It is der Kuchen, so the little word is der.

10. A — third
   der dritte means third.

11. B — eighth
   der achte means eighth.

12. C — die Karotte
   carrot in German is die Karotte.

13. C — die Getränke
   der Saft belongs to die Getränke.

14. B — das Abendessen
   supper in German is das Abendessen.

15. D — Zahn
   Zahn has a silent h after the a.

16. D — die Zähne
   The plural of der Zahn is die Zähne.

17. A — wolkig
   cloudy in German is wolkig.

18. B — die
   It is die Wolke, so the little word is die.

19. D — der
   Wand is a die word, so an der Wand.

20. D — under
   unter means under.

SECTION B
----
21. (3 marks)
   Answer: Januar, Februar, März.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correctly spelled month with a capital letter.

22. (2 marks)
   Answer: das Mittagessen, die Karotte.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

23. (3 marks)
   Answer: dem with der and das nouns (dem Tisch, dem Bett) and der with die nouns (der Tür).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for dem with der nouns, 1 mark for dem with das nouns, 1 mark for der with die nouns.

24. (2 marks)
   Answer: der Löffel, das Abendessen.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

25. (3 marks)
   Answer: die Wolke, der Kuchen, der Zeh.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

26. (3 marks)
   Answer: Oktober, November, Dezember.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correctly spelled month with a capital letter.

27. (2 marks)
   Answer: die Oma, die Uhr.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

28. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Guten Morgen, Amina, Kenia. Nouns, names and the first word of a sentence begin with capitals.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for examples, 1 mark for nouns, 1 mark for names.

29. (2 marks)
   Answer: das Knie, der Garten.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

30. (2 marks)
   Answer: Die Lampe ist neben dem Bett.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the sentence pattern and 1 mark for neben dem Bett.

31. (2 marks)
   Answer: Write only to people you know; do not share private information; ask an adult first.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each rule.

32. (3 marks)
   Answer: der Tisch, der Kühlschrank, die Küche.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).
